saas-landing.tagline: Vibrant SaaS landing page with a rounded frame
saas-landing.about: A production-ready landing page for SaaS products and startups. Features a parallax hero section, bento grid layout, auto-rotating testimonials, scroll-driven animations, and dark mode support. All content is managed through a single configuration file.

minimal-landing.about: A clean, minimal landing page with bold typography and a unique WebGL dither cursor effect. Features smooth Lenis scrolling, animated statistics counters, horizontal testimonial carousel, and a centralized configuration file for easy customization.

agency-site.tagline: Creative agency site with smooth scrolling
agency-site.about: A landing page for creative agencies and design studios. Features a WebGL wave shader hero, water ripple project cards, GSAP scroll-triggered animations, pinned sections, and a sticky reveal footer. Light/dark mode with smooth transitions, optimized for accessibility.

finance-landing.about: A professional landing page for fintech, banking, and financial services. Features a 3D animated hero background, interactive feature cards, phone mockup showcase, animated statistics counters, auto-scrolling testimonials, and 3-tier pricing. Light/dark mode optimized for accessibility.

ai-saas-landing.tagline: AI product landing page with a fluid cursor
ai-saas-landing.about: A landing page for AI products and SaaS applications. Features a WebGL fluid cursor, image bulge effects on showcase cards, GSAP scroll-triggered image reveal gallery, draggable tools carousel, and animated statistics bars. Light/dark mode optimized for accessibility.
